SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(REQUNO) AS LEGACY_PO_NO FROM BOL_PO_KEP_PURCHASE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY REQUNO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'BNGS' AS BUYER, 'KM' AS SITE, DELY_TO_LOCATION AS PLANT , REQUNO, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ , BUYER_ITEM_NO , STATUS , CURRENCY_CODE , PRIMARY_UOM AS UNIT_MEASURE , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_QTY , ITEM_AMT , ADD_DATE , RD_DATE , DELY_TO_LOCATION , DELY_DETAIL_LOC AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, PURCHASER_USER_ID , LEGACY_PR_NO||'-'||LEGACY_PR_SEQ||'-'||REQUNO AS LEGACY_PR_NO , LEGACY_PR_SEQ , REQ_USER_NAME , REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , REQ_USER_NAME||' '||REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME||' '||REQ_USER_TEL AS REQ_USER_INFO , REMARK , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , ADVANCE_FLAG AS DOC_TYPE FROM BOL_PO_KEP_PURCHASE WHERE 1=1 AND REQUNO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY REQUNO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE BOL_PO_KEP_PURCHASE SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND REQUNO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
